evidence_items.explanation: This supports the limited reliability clause for GPT-4 at release. It does not demonstrate that anthropomorphic treatment causes hype or unwarranted trust.

The May 2024 report finds no effect of its manipulated cues on overall system trust, although voice increased perceived answer accuracy and some pronoun effects depended on context. These reported results qualify a broad trust claim; the collection date and applicability to April 2023 were not established.

unresolved_gaps: The records do not establish the complete causal chain from anthropomorphic treatment to hype and unwarranted reliance in early 2023.
Experimental effects differ by cue, context and trust measure.
The alternative reading denying all manipulation or decision-making capacity would require a separate assessment.
